items.title: Bittle will start, along with Malachi Smith, Tyreke Key, Kevin McCullar, and the also-returning Andre Jackson Jr.
items.author: Blake Murphy
items.body_excerpt:
Bittle will start, along with Malachi Smith, Tyreke Key, Kevin McCullar, and the also-returning Andre Jackson Jr.

Markelle Fultz returns to the team, too, coming off the bench.

quote.author: Blake Murphy
quote.text:
Nate Bittle is expected to make his Raptors 905 debut tonight.

media.title: Raptors' Nate Bittle ready to return, build on Summer League buzz
media.description:
